thread:
lee: FYI we're planning a slim-root rebake + signer rotation for runtime nodes Friday 07:00 PT. Objectives: drop ancient crypto libs, rotate cosign key stored in KMS, and keep audit records tied to image SHA -> SBOM -> signature. Need quick RBAC + KMS sanity check before canary.

nina: Recommend 3-wave canary: 3%, 20%, full. After each wave run SBOM+sig validation job.

infra: RBAC note: runtime-signer service account currently has kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter but lacks kms.cryptoKeySigner. Also need to grant ops-verifier cloudkms.publicKeyViewer so cross-project cosign verify works.

lee: Can you paste the minimal IAM delta? I'll add to infra MR template.

infra: Minimal (GCP style):
```
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> serviceAccount:runtime-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer -> serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Also ensure attestor emits audit logs (auditlog:write) when promoting tags.

ops-bot: CI scan flagged a zlib version diff on candidate image (allowlist drift). Link: https://ci.internal/scan/17501 (warning).

nina: I'll triage zlib against NVD and our internal DB. If no CVE it's non-blocking. ETA 1h.

sre-oncall: Rollback play: if canary error spike >4% or signature mismatch, revert registry tag and redeploy previous image. Snippet I'll keep in runbook: 
```
# revert registry tag to previous sha
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy previous image
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:prev-sha -n runtime || kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n runtime
```

lee: Ops asked for a sample audit payload to accept the new SBOM+sig pairing. Quick example: 
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:aa11bb22cc33",
  "sbom_url": "gs://sbom-bucket/sha256-aa11bb22.json",
  "signature_id": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/cosign/signatures/7f8a",
  "promoted_by": "serviceAccount:ci-deployer",
  "timestamp": "2025-07-18T14:00:00Z"
}
```

infra: MR created: https://git.internal/infra/mr/6120 includes terraform change + test plan. Please review.

nina: Quick vuln triage update: zlib bump shows no CVEs in NVD/internal DB. Non-blocker. Attaching SBOM diff to MR.

ops-bot: Reminder: CI job `sbom-validate` will run post-signing; ensure it posts signature metadata to audit service.

sre-oncall: I'll watch during the window and page SRE if we see anything odd.

lee: Action items: 1) infra to land IAM MR after approvals, 2) nina attach SBOM diff + triage note, 3) sre-oncall add rollback snippet and monitor Friday, 4) lee to upload runbook and calendar. Canary start Friday 07:00 PT.

infra: Approved by infra lead and security. Will merge once CI green.

lee: Thanks everyone. Merging infra MR after second approval and posting runbook link once live.
